admission.justification: The helper tests catch accidental mixed/truncated waivers, while the nearest-boundary transport proof catches loss of already admitted named debt at payload, log, public projection or persistence.

applicability: External non-leaf recorded landings whose supplied code is already reachable on a local admitted landing target.
conditions: Every gate finding is shown and is knowledge-stale-at-landing; an empty or truncated set is not admitted as debt.
The independent landed-chain proof, reachability and every other admission predicate pass before stale-only debt is accepted.
The public projection retains staleEntries; apply persists nonempty record keys through the shared writer.
exclusions: Converted-leaf pair judgment, mixed findings, missing targets, unreachable commits and invalid master history remain refusals.
